overview:
Pasadena CA PD uses Flock Safety technology to capture objective evidence without compromising on individual privacy. Pasadena CA PD utilizes retroactive search to solve crimes after they've occurred. Additionally, Pasadena CA PD utilizes real time alerting of hotlist vehicles to capture wanted criminals. In an effort to ensure proper usage and guardrails are in place, they have made the below policies and usage statistics available to the public.

success_stories:
On July 31, 2026, a strong armed robbery occurred in the 700 block of east Washington Blvd. during which time a female victim was punched several times by three male suspects who proceeded to take items belonging to her. Utilizing Flock, officers were able to identify the suspect vehicle, locate the suspects, and recover the loss.


On June 6, 2026, the Pasadena Police Department received a call reporting a suspect brandishing a firearm during a road rage incident. Utilizing Flock, officers were able to quickly identify and locate the suspect vehicle. This subsequently led to the arrest of a convicted felon and the recovery of the loaded firearm in the center console of the suspect's vehicle.
